OptiAssist is a maintenance, diagnostic, and post-installation tool that runs exclusively with elevated Administrator privileges.

Administrator execution was not authorized or the application was started without elevated rights.

Welcome_Subtitle: Modular System Maintenance, Diagnostic, and Post-Install Assistant
Welcome_Notice_Text: OptiAssist is a powerful toolkit designed for IT professionals and power users that performs deep system administrative operations (including system integrity checks, DISM/SFC repairs, system cleaning, and startup adjustments). Administrative commands modify low-level Windows settings. Ensure you review and understand actions prior to executing them.
